notes: Launchers follow Transition's /home/claude/pilot_shared/TRANSITION_DEMO_ARGS.md (branch feature/pm-pilot-transitions @ 903634afa51237e29fd306ae815c880415230f17 at the time of writing). The same arguments go into every variant so comparisons are like for like: --pm-staged-stair is opt-in and ignored by builds that do not contain the pilot. Seeds equal the Transition fixtures PM-Canal-Left.json and PM-Stair-Cinematic.json (checked against the candidate's own fixture file when it exists in the source). Seeded unlocks are QA fixtures, not earned progression.

default.name: Fresh
default.describe: Unseeded campaign with the staged stair on; its own persistent profile in the package folder.

default.name: Canal-Left
default.describe: Room 13 Mooring Loft, feet (330,1158) on the shelf in the hallway. Hold A: the left exit is an automatic passage, no E.

default.name: Cinematic-Pilot
default.describe: Room 14 Bellroof Walk, 40 px left of the stair. Press E at the stair: staged R14 to R17 sequence (about 2.35 s) when the pilot is present.

default.name: Cinematic-Reduced
default.describe: Same stair, reduced motion from launch (about 0.95 s, no camera move). F6 toggles live.

notes_w3: Wave 3 launcher set (BUILD-07). Arguments are FINAL per /home/claude/wave3_shared/TR08_DEMO_ARGS.md (Transition PR64 head 308bbf10): TR-08 is default-on and needs no flag; --tr08-off restores PR61; --pm-staged-stair is an OFF switch for TR-08. Builds without TR-08 (control, level-only, art-only) get --pm-staged-stair on stair launchers so the control shows the previous staged stair for a like-for-like comparison. --ld05-open-top is ignored by builds without LD-05. Seeded unlocks are QA fixtures, not earned progression.

w3.name: Fresh
w3.describe: Unseeded campaign, its own persistent profile in the package folder.

w3.name: Stair-Fullscreen
w3.describe: Room 14 Bellroof Walk, feet (1410,478), 40 px left of the stair. Press E: full-screen ascent R14 to R17 (about 2.9 s in TR-08 builds).

w3.name: Stair-Return
w3.describe: Room 17 Counterweight Spire, feet (1650,1298), 30 px left of the stair. Press E: full-screen descent R17 to R14.

w3.name: Canal-Doorway
w3.describe: Room 13 Mooring Loft, feet (330,1158) on the hallway shelf. Hold A (no E): through the Canal doorway to R0 (TR-08: embodied passage, about 1.9 s; other builds: the screen wipe).

w3.name: Canal-Return
w3.describe: Room 0 Canal Haven, feet (650,778), 60 px right of the Mooring Loft door. Press E: through the R0 door, emerging from the Canal doorway in R13 (TR-08 about 3.0 to 3.5 s).

w3.name: Geometry-Test
w3.describe: LD-05 geometry test: all 21 rooms already visited on the map, all abilities unlocked, start R13. Walk the rooms listed in GEOMETRY_TEST.txt and try to leave the intended space; roof course and wall caps are on.

w3.name: Geometry-OpenTop
w3.describe: Same as Geometry-Test with the LD-05 roof course switched off (--ld05-open-top), for before/after comparison. No effect in builds without LD-05.

w3.name: Reduced-Stair
w3.describe: Same as Stair-Fullscreen with reduced motion from launch. F6 toggles live.

w3.name: Reduced-Canal
w3.describe: Same as Canal-Doorway with reduced motion from launch. F6 toggles live.
